paite: Na lak uah kuapeuh in midang toh thubuai neita le uchin, misiangthoute ma a tun lou in, midiktatloute ma ah na tun ngam ding ua hia?
heading: Khristiante Kihek Thu

paite: Ahihleh misiangthoute'n khovel tung a vaihawm ding ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khovel mite tung a bawn vaihawm ding na hih uleh, thil neupente leng ngaihtuah tak lou na hi ua hia?
Tulai damsung thute gen louh angelte nangawn i vaihawm ding uh ahi chih na thei kei ua hia?
Huchi in tulai damsung thute ngaihtuah ding na neih un bangziak a saptuamte ngaihniam pente ngaihtuahsak na hi ua?
Na zumna ding un ka gen ahi. A-unaute kal a thu hihpuk thei mipil, khat bek na lak uah na mu kei ua ahi ding maw?
Unau in a-unau mah ginglou mite vaihawmna a atut zawk nak!
Hilou ahi, hiai na diklouhna khat uh ahi pah hi, thubuai na kineih tuah nak uh. Bangziak a dikloupi a hihna na thuak zaw lou? Bang achia kizangsak zaw mai lou oi?
Hilou ahi, noumau ngei in na unaute uh tung ah leng na hihdik kei ua, na zangsak uhi.
Ahihleh midiktatloute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh chih na thei kei ua hia? Khem in om kei un, kingaihhatte, milim bete, angkawmte leh mihukte leh tokohukte,
gutate, mihuaihamte, zukhamhatte, salhhatte leh lepgute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh.
Huan noute khenkhat huchibang na hi uh; himahleh Toupa Jesu Khrist min in leh i Pathian Kha ah siansak na hita ua, hihsiangthou na hita ua, siamtang na hita uhi.
"Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoihkim kei, "Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh bangmah sikha ding in ka kiphal kei hi.
heading: Pumpi Hiangte Zatna Dik

paite: "Nek dingte gilpi a ahi a, gilpi leng nek ding a ahi," himahleh Pathian in ahihmang tuaktuak ding. Huan pumpi pen kingaihna ding ahi kei a, Toupa a ding ahi; Toupa leng pumpi a ding ahi;
Pathian in misi lak a kipan Toupa akaithou a, eite leng athilhihtheihna in hon kaithou sam ding hi.
Na pumpi uh Khrist hiang ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khrist hiangte laksak in kizuak hiang ding peuh in ka bawl dia hia?
Bawl lou hial ding. Ahihleh kizuak zop amah toh pum khat ahi uh chih na thei kei ua hia? "Anih un sapum khat ahi ding uh," achi ngal a.
Toupa zop bel amah toh kha pum khat ahi uhi.
Kingaih taisan un. Mihing thilhihkhelh chiteng pumpi polam ah ahi; mingaih hat in bel amah pumpi tung ah thil ahihkhial hi.
Ahihleh na pumpi uh, na sung ua om Pathian kiang a kipan a na muh uh, Kha Siangthou tempul ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Noumau a leng na hi kei ua,
man a leisa na hih ziak un, na pumpi uh leh na kha Pathian a mah in, Pathian pahtawi un.
